title: Blueberry Smoothie Bowl with Homemade Granola
excerpt: A creamy, intense bowl full of frozen blueberries, served with a crunchy homemade granola baked on the spot. Perfect to start the morning with flavor and freshness.
imageAlt: Thick violet smoothie bowl topped with fresh blueberries, crunchy granola and chia seeds.
steps: For the granola, preheat the oven to 160°C (320°F). In a bowl, mix the oats, almonds, honey, coconut oil and cinnamon until everything is well combined.
Spread the mixture on a tray lined with baking paper and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and crisp. Let cool.
For the smoothie, blend 2 cups of the Fresh Pick blueberries (previously frozen) with the Greek yogurt and the lemon juice until you get a creamy, firm texture.
Divide the frozen blueberry cream between two deep bowls.
Top with the cooled homemade granola, the remaining half cup of fresh blueberries and the chia right before serving.
tips: We use Fresh Pick blueberries grown in the high mountains of Guasca, whose natural sweetness perfectly balances the freshness of the smoothie without adding any sugar.
To get the creamy, dense texture typical of a smoothie bowl, freeze the blueberries at least 4 hours before blending them.
You can keep leftover homemade granola in a tightly closed airtight glass jar so it stays crunchy for up to two weeks.
